content.text:
The design system is the correct owner for light mode, but it exists on a separate branch rather than `main`.

- `main` (`c81b4f7`) uses a monolithic [styles.css](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/styles.css:1). Its root fixes `color-scheme: dark`, defines five color variables, and leaves many literal dark colors in search controls, badges, tooltips, skeletons, footer, and links. Date inputs separately force dark mode around line 968.
- `design-system` (`919453b`) lives at `/Users/jamie/development/exposed.design-system`. [tokens.css](/Users/jamie/development/exposed.design-system/frontend/src/lib/ui/tokens.css:1) owns canvas, surface, text, muted text, member/funder accents, dividers, warning, action ink, spacing, typography, and focus tokens. [base.css](/Users/jamie/development/exposed.design-system/frontend/src/lib/ui/base.css:1) applies them and currently fixes `color-scheme: dark`.
- [The layout](/Users/jamie/development/exposed.design-system/frontend/src/routes/+layout.svelte:1) loads `lib/ui/styles.css` before application CSS. The UI stylesheet imports tokens, base, actions, and patterns. Reusable components come from the public `lib/ui/index.ts` barrel. Feature components still own data, formatting, chart geometry, URLs, analytics, and page composition, per [README.md](/Users/jamie/development/exposed.design-system/frontend/src/lib/ui/README.md:1).
- Color migration is incomplete even on the design-system branch: application CSS retains literal header/footer borders and selection colors. Audit `patterns.css`, `actions.css`, and scoped `Field`/`Notice` styles alongside tokens. Preserve semantic party chart colors in `lib/funder-summary.ts`; these identify parties rather than application surfaces.
- `/design-system` is a development-only gallery with no API requirement. Its [route loader](/Users/jamie/development/exposed.design-system/frontend/src/routes/design-system/+page.ts:1) returns 404 outside development. `tests/design-system.spec.ts` provides existing component behavior coverage.

There is already a separate implementation: branch `codex/issue-91-light-theme`, commit `a019244`, at `/Users/jamie/development/exposed-issue-91-theme`. It introduces a lavender light palette following the system preference, but targets the pre-design-system stylesheet. Its [theme tests](/Users/jamie/development/exposed-issue-91-theme/frontend/tests/theme.spec.ts:1) are useful reference material: both schemes, native date controls, search loading/empty/error states, keyboard focus, text contrast ≥4.5, and control borders ≥3.

Recommended implementation: build on the design-system branch, move theme values into its token layer, let native controls inherit the active color scheme, and replace remaining surface/control literals with semantic tokens. Port the older theme branch’s behavior and tests deliberately rather than applying its monolithic CSS changes wholesale. No files changed and no checks run.
